newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - LTX Corp '97 EPS estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - LTX Corp '97 EPS estimate cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal Investment Research said on Wednesday it lowered its fiscal 1997 estimate for earnings per share from operations for LTX Corp to $0.05 from $0.50. It introduced a projected fiscal 1998 earnings estimate of $0.80 per share.
-- Associate analyst Doug Makin said the company's rating remained unchanged at outperform long-term, with a buy for long-term accounts that can tolerate volatility.

-- LTX Corp, which makes systems to test semiconductors, on Tuesday reported a first quarter operating loss of $0.08 and took a restructuring charge of $0.45 per share versus a $0.19 profit during the same period last year. The results were below expectations.

-- Analyst Mona Eraiba in commentary said she had "low confidence in our estimates" due to the nature of the semiconductor market and because the restructuring could cause an unknown amount of storage leverage on the upside.
-- "We expect the company to experience a stronger recovery in orders during the first half of 1997," she added. "We believe that LTXX shares present an outstanding long-term value."
-- LTX Corp shares were trading at 5-1/8, up 31/64. -- Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787
